title: uptide.yml
description: Settings for Uptide: which dependencies it upgrades, when, and whether it may call an LLM.

version.description: Format of this file. Only 1 exists.

packages.description: Which dependencies Uptide considers, as npm package name globs. Deny wins over allow.

allow.description: Only these dependencies. Empty: every dependency.

deny.description: Never these dependencies, even when allow matches them.

schedule.description: When the workflow runs: a five-field cron expression in UTC, or `manual` to run only when started from the Actions tab or the Uptide dashboard. The workflow file holds a copy; run `uptide init` again after changing it.

maxOpenPrs.description: No new pull request is opened while this many Uptide pull requests are open.

llm.description: Assisted fixes for the sites no rule covers.

enabled.description: false: no code is sent to an LLM provider; rule-based fixes only.

provider.description: Which provider receives the code, with this repository's own API key.

maxCost.description: Most a run may spend on LLM calls, in USD.

executor.description: How assisted fixes are applied: auto (SDK for Anthropic when installed, patch otherwise), patch (one edit per site), sdk (a Claude Agent SDK session).

min-release-age.description: Days a release must be public before Uptide targets it, for a repository with no policy of its own (npm min-release-age, pnpm minimumReleaseAge, Yarn npmMinimalAgeGate); the repository's policy wins. Unset: no minimum.
